title: Marketing Acquisition Lead
description:
AnyRoad is the leading experiential marketing platform that empowers brands to optimize events, tours, activations, and classes, driving brand loyalty, revenue, and measurable ROI. Backed by the world's leading investment firms (A16Z, Blackrock), the platform streamlines experiential operations through a flexible and customizable system, providing powerful analytics to fuel business growth. Trusted by industry leaders such as Anheuser-Busch, Diageo, LVMH, Coca-Cola, and Arc'teryx, AnyRoad is a proven platform for scaling impactful experiential marketing programs. By helping brands scale their operations, AnyRoad plays a pivotal role in enhancing consumer engagement and delivering measurable outcomes.
We're hiring a Marketing Acquisition Lead for our loyalty platform to help brands launch, manage, and grow their own loyalty, engagement, and membership programs. You'll own the full lifecycle of brand marketing campaigns: strategy, execution, measurement, and iteration. Email and SMS will be your primary channels, but you'll also run social, influencer, and other campaigns as opportunities emerge.
This is a high-impact, hands-on role for a full-stack marketer who can design campaigns, execute quickly, and continuously optimize performance. Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you'll work directly with our executive and creative teams, interface regularly with brand partners, and have the opportunity to make a significant impact at a thriving startup.
What You’ll Do:

• Own end-to-end campaign strategy and execution across email and SMS, plus social, influencer, and other channels as needed

• Build, launch, and optimize campaigns that help our brand partners acquire, engage, and retain loyal customers

• Manage our marketing CRM and the systems that support campaign operations

• Optimize campaign performance by analyzing key metrics, running creative and audience tests, fine-tuning targeting and copy, and adjusting strategies to improve results

• Partner directly with brand clients on strategy sessions and reviews; travel occasionally for client meetings, team offsites, and key events

• Report weekly to leadership with clear insights, recommendations, and results tied to KPIs

• Collaborate with executive and design teams to launch cohesive, high-quality campaigns

What We’re Looking For:

• 3-5 years of experience in marketing with a focus on user acquisition

• Proven experience running email and SMS campaigns end-to-end

• Comfortable owning both strategy and execution

• Strong analytical mindset; confident working with campaign data and performance metrics

• Experience testing and scaling multiple acquisition channels (social, influencer, etc.) and campaigns simultaneously

• Familiarity with modern marketing stacks (CRM, automation tools, attribution, etc.). Klaviyo experience a plus.

• Experience using AI tools regularly in your workflow (content, analysis, automation)

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills (native or near-native fluency)

• Comfortable in client-facing environments interacting with brand partners and representing AnyRoad in strategic conversations

• Willing and able to travel periodically for client meetings, team gatherings, and events

• Thrives in a fast-paced startup environment with high ownership

Location:
The team is based in San Francisco. We're looking for someone who lives in the Americas with strong overlap with US business hours, and who can travel occasionally for client meetings.

title: Procurement Enablement Lead
description:
About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at .

About the Operational Finance Team
The Operational Finance Team is responsible for a variety of tasks that are instrumental in keeping the business running on a day to day basis. There are four teams within the Operational Finance Function each serve a specific purpose to the company: Accounting and Accounts Payable - Accurately records all vendor related transactions and keeps our vendors paid, Billing Team - provisions all customers access to mixpanel and ensure proper revenue recognition, Collection Team - records all customer payments and ensures we get paid on time, Payroll - prepares payrolls for all employees world wide. The team is split between the Bay Area, London, Bangalore and Barcelona.
About the Role
The Procurement Enablement Lead will lead the procurement program at Mixpanel . They will manage a team of two, and will be responsible for organizational spend, maximizing vendor value, optimizing procurement processes, minimizing risk, and assisting business partners throughout the organization with the procurement of third-party tools and services.
This role requires a breadth of experience and both strategic and operational skills, along with proven people-management capability. A successful candidate will enjoy building and developing a team while using their skillset to streamline operations, enhance processes, and continuously support and educate others to develop a world-class procurement program.
Responsibilities

• Manage and develop a team of two, coaching them through skill-building, career growth, and day-to-day performance while fostering a culture of shared ownership and high standards.

• Lead execution of complex procurement projects across functions, setting clear priorities and anticipating challenges before they become blockers.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with key internal teams such as FP&A, Security, IT and Legal on purchasing processes and improvements, building productive relationships with adjacent teams and resolving misalignments directly.

• Build strategic relationships with key vendors and technology partners in order to leverage strategic discounts and maximize value.

• Promote a culture of innovation on the team by identifying opportunities to improve outcomes through better processes and targeted use of AI and emerging tools, and lead initiatives to implement procurement process improvements.

• Provide procurement process training for Mixpanel employees involved with procurement of products and services.

• Shape and communicate a compelling vision for the procurement team that contributes to Operational Finance goals, anticipating team-level needs and emerging trends, and clearly communicating the rationale behind key decisions.

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

• 5+ years of work experience as a Procurement Specialist or Procurement Manager, including experience managing or directly leading others.

• Experience working for SaaS companies and working directly with vendors.

• Experience with Procurement improvement initiatives.

• Understanding of market dynamics and sound business judgment.

• Experience with managing and mitigating risks.

• Strong data management and analytics skills - you have the ability to gather, clean and interpret data.

• Ability to negotiate and sustain networking relationships both internally and externally.

• Effective communicator as you will need to collaborate with all functions of the business and guide a team through change with clarity and empathy.

• A track record of coaching and developing team members, managing performance, and building a respectful, high-performing team environme

Who we are
Adlib is the AI Production Layer for regulated industries. We turn complex, unstructured documents into governed, validated, AI-ready data so that enterprises can make defensible decisions without rebuilding their stack.
For insurance carriers, that means agentic intake across the documents that drive the business: FNOL packets, police reports, medical records, adjuster notes, loss runs, submissions, endorsements and certificates. Adlib classifies, extracts, validates and scores each document for trust, then hands clean data to the core systems and AI models already in place. Customers see 60% fewer exceptions, 50% faster cycle times and 70% less manual handling.
On top of that trusted data layer sits our agentic intake capability. Agents read the packet, decide what it is, apply carrier rules, route the exception and trigger the next action in the workflow. We are model-agnostic and system-agnostic by design. We sit in front of Guidewire, Duck Creek, Sapiens, Majesco and the rest of the core stack rather than replacing any of it. Adlib is backed by Diversis Capital and serves Fortune 1000 customers across insurance, life sciences and public sector.

title: Associate Director, Product Management
description:

We’re generating chemical data purpose-built to propel drug discovery into the information age - and we’re doing it on a larger scale and faster than has ever before been possible.
Our closed loop system generates precise chemical datasets at unrivaled scale that work seamlessly with AI to systematically map biochemical interactions between small molecules and causes of disease. Iterative cycles of virtual molecular design and experimentation power AI and machine learning models, which in turn guide the next cycle of design. With a chemistry engine that measures billions of interactions daily and becomes increasingly precise with every cycle, we can answer an unprecedented array of questions - deriving insights that enable us to predictably create drugs for patients in need.
Position Summary: Terray Therapeutics is seeking an Associate Director, Product Management to lead the product vision and execution for tDesign - an internal platform that serves as the central interface for our small molecule drug discovery programs. Reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer, this is a highly visible role where you will operate at the strategic center of the company, influencing how our science and technology converge to solve complex problems. You will empower our medicinal chemists and molecular design scientists by giving them intuitive access to our proprietary AI models through automated workflows and drug discovery agents. Concurrently, you will work with our ML engineers, software engineers, and other computational scientists to translate complex drug discovery needs into a seamless user experience that accelerates our ability to find novel cures.
The core responsibilities of this position are:

•
Strategic Product Leadership: Own the product lifecycle for tDesign, defining a roadmap that aligns with Terray’s high-level scientific and business goals. You will present regularly to executive leadership and key stakeholders on product impact and strategy.

•
User-Centric Design: Deeply understand the workflows of medicinal chemists, molecular design scientists, and small molecule program leads to improve and build features that solve real friction points in the design-make-test-analyze (DMTA) cycle. Translate complex internal scientific tools into intuitive, resilient user experiences suitable for broader deployment beyond the original development context.

•
Cross-Functional Orchestration: Act as the primary bridge between our scientific stakeholders and our engineering/AI teams. Partner with scientific stakeholders to ensure technical specifications accurately translate and support biological and chemical realities and drive alignment across the organization.

•
Agent & Workflow Integration: Lead the integration of new AI agents and automated workflows into the UI, making advanced computational tools accessible to non-computational experts.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. You will serve as the technical authority for access control, intrusion detection, video surveillance, intercommunications, radio, and network systems within the contract document set, working in close partnership with GSIS partners, Real Estate / Workplace, the Network Team, and other cross-functional stakeholders. title: Technical Enablement Manager
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Exa sells a technical product to technical buyers, through a technical sales motion. Our AEs need to speak fluently about the product and our FDEs need enablement that matches their skill level and doesn't waste their time. You're the person who makes both of those true.

You'll own technical enablement for the entire GTM org, both onboarding and everboarding. For FDEs, that means staying genuinely technical: demo excellence, POV/POC process, and raising the bar on what "good" looks like. For AEs, it means taking that same technical depth and translating it into something a seller can actually use as they navigate conversations with technical audiences, without losing the substance that makes it credible.

This role reports into the Head of Revenue Enablement. We're building the enablement function from the ground up with a focus on scale. We're growing the GTM sales team quickly, so early months are about building the onboarding infrastructure at the same time you're running it. Built so it scales, stays repeatable, and keeps improving.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Design and run technical onboarding for new AEs and FDEs - sessions, materials, and assessments built from scratch so new hires ramp with real fluency, not just familiarity

- Own ongoing (everboarding) enablement: product training, update briefings, and skill-building tied to real deal scenarios

- Turn new platform capabilities into field-ready content within days of launch including translating technical features to value based narrative, technical objection handling, quick-reference guides, and demo scenarios across industries and personas

- Coach technical sellers on demo delivery through practice sessions and office hours

- Build and maintain a library of enablement content: demo guides, technical objection handling, competitive positioning, hands-on labs, reference material for both technical and sales audiences

- Build the infrastructure that scales enablement without you in the room: self-service resources, demo environments, content-freshness automation

- Close the loop with product and product marketing by bringing back field signal on where sellers get stuck and what would unlock the next deal

- Track content usage and session feedback so you know what's working and what to retire

- Use AI tools to build smarter workflows and move faster, both in your own work and in what you build for the team

WHO YOU ARE

- 2-4 years in technical enablement, solutions engineering, sales engineering, technical training, or another role enabling technical seller personas

- Strong technical aptitude and curiosity. You don't need to be an engineer, but you're comfortable going deep on a complex product and turning that into accurate, credible enablement

- Comfortable building things yourself: prototyping a demo, scripting an automation, standing up a lightweight tool. You don't need to ship production code, but you can hold your own with people who do

- Proven ability to design and deliver training for both technical and sales audiences, and to translate between them

- Hands-on experience using AI in your own work, with real opinions on where it helps and where it doesn't

- A builder's instinct for scale - you'd rather build a system once than run the same sessions manually forever

- Comfortable being one of the founding enablement hires - no playbook to inherit, building from scratch, moving fast

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience building with LLM APIs or agent frameworks (tool use, MCP, etc.), beyond just prompting

- Experience delivering live technical training to mixed technical/non-technical audiences

- Familiarity with vector search, embeddings, or neural search concepts

LOCATION:

San Francisco (HQ) strongly preferred. Open to remote for the right candidate.

Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity

title: Associate Director/Senior Manager, Health Economics & Outcomes Research-Organ Health
description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a strategic, analytical, and highly collaborative leader to serve as our Associate Director/Senior Manager of Health Economics & Outcomes Research (HEOR) Organ Health. In this high-impact role, you will lead the development and execution of health economic and outcomes evidence demonstrating the clinical and economic value of Natera’s precision molecular diagnostic technologies across chronic kidney disease (CKD), transplant medicine and emerging indications.

You will develop health economic models, generate real-world and clinical-trial evidence, lead HEOR publication initiatives, and translate complex clinical and economic data into compelling evidence supporting market access, reimbursement, payer adoption, clinical adoption, and commercialization. Working across Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Biostatistics, Market Access, Commercial, Marketing, Regulatory, and Business Development, you will help integrate HEOR evidence throughout the product lifecycle-from clinical development and evidence generation through publication, reimbursement, and payer adoption.

This is a strategic role for an experienced HEOR professional who combines strong technical capabilities with scientific communication, business acumen, and the ability to influence cross-functional evidence strategy.

 

Why Join Us

At Natera, you will have the opportunity to shape the economic evidence strategy supporting innovative precision diagnostics and biomarker-guided approaches to patient care. You will work at the intersection of clinical evidence, health economics, market access, and commercialization, translating clinical innovation into measurable value for patients, providers, health systems, and payers.

You will collaborate with internal leaders, investigators, key opinion leaders, and external research partners to generate evidence capable of influencing reimbursement decisions, clinical adoption, health technology assessments, and healthcare policy across U.S. and global markets.

 

Key Responsibilities

• Health Economic Modeling & Value Demonstration: Lead the development, validation, and application of health economic models, including budget impact, cost-effectiveness, cost-utility, cost-consequence, ROI, decision-tree, Markov/state-transition, partitioned-survival, and other economic models. Develop scenario and sensitivity analyses that quantify the clinical and economic value of precision diagnostics across different payer and healthcare-system perspectives.

• Clinical Development & HEOR Evidence Strategy: Partner with Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Biostatistics, and other cross-functional teams to integrate HEOR objectives into prospective clinical studies, including healthcare resource utilization, economic endpoints, patient-reported outcomes, quality-of-life measures, cost-data collection, and real-world evidence strategies. Ensure evidence-generation plans anticipate future payer, reimbursement, and HTA requirements.

• Real-World Evidence & Outcomes Research: Analyze clinical-trial, observational, and real-world datasets to evaluate healthcare resource utilization, cost of care, treatment pathways, diagnostic utilization, clinical utility, comparative effectiveness, patient outcomes, survival, budget impact, and quality-adjusted life years. Translate findings into actionable evidence supporting clinical, payer, and business decisions.

• Publication & Scientific Evidence Leadership: Lead HEOR publication strategy and development of peer-reviewed manuscripts, scientific abstracts, conference posters, oral presentations, white papers, and technical reports. Coordinate publication plans and timelines with investigators, key opinion leaders, academic collaborators, and external research partners to ensure evidence generation is aligned with strategic business priorities.

Companies buy Brex to run their spend, and the person on the hook for that is the finance admin - a controller, an accounting manager, a finance ops lead. Their job comes down to two things they can never quite get ahead of: making sure money is being spent compliantly and documented in time to close the books, and knowing where the company's money is actually going.

Today they do both by hand, at a scale that doesn't work. Roughly 4% of travel and entertainment spend is out of policy - for a company spending $10M a year, that's $400K in violations, duplicates, missing receipts, and overspend. Most companies never find it, because finding it means a human reading transactions one at a time. The ones who do find it either staff a review team or bolt on a separate audit product with its own login. On the other side, the questions that actually matter - where did spend grow this quarter, which team is drifting, what's driving the number - sit behind a queue for an analyst, or a spreadsheet the admin builds themselves at month-end. Nobody is continuously watching.

title: Content Marketing Manager
description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Content Marketing Manager will develop content that advances Harvey's brand and business goals across editorial, campaigns, and social. This person will turn company priorities, customer insights, and market opportunities into high-quality content, then work across teams to distribute it effectively and measure its impact. This is a role for a strong writer and editor who is equally comfortable shaping strategy and producing the work itself, and who can translate complex legal, technical, and product ideas into clear, compelling stories.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Contribute to Harvey's editorial strategy and help execute the content roadmap set by the Head of Content and Social Strategy.

- Write and edit content across formats, including website articles, guides, reports, thought leadership, social series, video scripts, and campaign copy.

- Turn complex legal, technical, and product ideas into clear, compelling stories for Harvey's audiences.

- Develop content-led campaigns in partnership with product marketing, demand generation, communications, social, and other teams.

- Create distribution strategies that extend the reach and value of each major content asset.

- Write planned social copy and captions connected to editorial content, campaigns, launches, and brand initiatives.

- Partner with the SEO lead to apply search insights to content planning, development, and optimization.

- Use audience and performance data to understand what is working and improve future content.

- Maintain a consistent, distinctive Harvey voice across channels and formats.

- Partner with Content Operations and Publishing to move work efficiently through production, review, and publication.

WHAT YOU HAVE

- 5+ years of experience in content marketing, editorial, or a closely related discipline, ideally in B2B technology, SaaS, or professional services.

- Exceptional writing and editing skills, with a portfolio that demonstrates range across long-form editorial, thought leadership, campaign copy, and social.

- A proven ability to translate complex or technical subject matter into clear, engaging narratives for sophisticated audiences.

- Experience contributing to an editorial strategy and delivering against a content roadmap, taking ownership of high-quality output end to end.

- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with a track record of partnering with product marketing, demand generation, communications, and social teams.

- Familiarity with SEO fundamentals and comfort using search insights to shape content.

- Fluency with content performance metrics and the judgment to turn data into better editorial decisions.

- A sharp eye for brand voice and the discipline to maintain it consistently across channels and formats.

title: Compliance Testing Data Analyst
description:
The Compliance Testing Data Analyst is an individual contributor who provides data analytics, automation, and reporting expertise in support of Aqua’s Compliance Testing and Monitoring program. This role analyzes data, develops scalable testing and monitoring solutions, identifies trends and risks, and produces reliable reporting to support effective compliance oversight.
Essential Functions

• Support the execution of the Compliance Testing and Monitoring program through data analysis, population identification and validation, sampling support, testing workbook preparation, results aggregation, and exception analysis.

• Collect, validate, reconcile, and analyze data from internal systems, business reports, GRC tools, SharePoint, Excel workbooks, and other approved data sources used in compliance testing and monitoring activities.

• Develop, maintain, document, and enhance compliance testing methodologies and analytics routines, including data logic, testing rules, exception criteria, thresholds, sampling logic, repeatable queries, and testing outputs.

• Develop and maintain testing data files, dashboards, metrics, reports, trackers, and recurring monitoring routines to support timely, accurate, and consistent testing execution and reporting.

• Develop and enhance automated and semi-automated testing, monitoring, and reporting solutions using tools such as Excel, Power BI, Power Automate, SharePoint, SQL, and other approved analytics, reporting, or workflow tools.

• Analyze large data populations to identify trends, outliers, anomalies, potential exceptions, repeat issues, control weaknesses, and emerging compliance risks.

• Support risk-based testing by translating test objectives into data requirements, identifying relevant populations and testing attributes, supporting sample selection, and validating the completeness and reliability of data used for testing.

• Prepare clear and accurate testing results summaries, exception reports, trend analyses, dashboards, metrics, and management reporting that communicate testing outcomes, risk themes, identified issues, and remediation status.

• Support testing execution and workpaper quality by preparing and maintaining accurate, complete, organized, and independently reviewable data extracts, sampling files, calculations, evidence, supporting documentation, exception validation, and testing results.

• Assist Compliance Testing team members with data preparation, exception validation, evidence gathering, issue documentation, root cause analysis support, remediation validation, and retesting activities.

• Maintain testing-related schedules, trackers, reporting inventories, issue validation logs, action item logs, and documentation repositories to support effective program governance, transparency, and timely completion of testing activities.

• Partner with Compliance, Legal, Risk, Audit, IT, Data, and Business Unit stakeholders to obtain data, clarify data definitions and requirements, resolve data quality issues, and support timely completion of testing and monitoring activities.

• Support compliance testing reporting and data requests for the Chief Compliance Officer, senior management, management committees, bank partners, audits, examinations, regulators, and other oversight stakeholders.

• Identify and implement opportunities to improve testing efficiency, reporting consistency, data quality, automation, monitoring routines, documentation, and repeatability of testing processes.

• Support special projects and perform other duties as assigned.

• Bachelor’s degree in related field, or commensurate work experience, required
